Sandbox_medWorks_RequireRecoveryKnowledg: Read the field-safety magazine and anatomical recovery manual before recovering parts. Does not authorize surgery on living patients.
Sandbox_medWorks_EnableCorpseRecovery_to: Allow timed recovery from corpses with preserved anatomy and provenance. Requires a carried working saw.
Sandbox_medWorks_CorpseRecoverySeconds_t: Time for each recovered part. Movement cancels the action without consuming anatomy.
Sandbox_medWorks_EnableExaminations_tool: Add a timed read-only examination option to the vanilla health-panel body-part menu.
Sandbox_medWorks_ExaminationSeconds_tool: Base duration before B47ANCE'd Health Care reports current observable findings.
Sandbox_medWorks_EnableSunburnCare_toolt: Optional Spectrum self-care. Consumes one vanilla cold pack from main inventory; does not treat another player.
Sandbox_medWorks_SunburnCareSeconds_tool: Server-owned native timed-action duration; walking or running interrupts the action.
Sandbox_medWorks_SunburnCareReduction: Sunburn dose reduction per cold pack
Sandbox_medWorks_SunburnCareReduction_to: Normalized gameplay dose reduction per consumed cold pack. Provisional balance; not a medical simulation.
